definition: CryoSat-2 orbit counter: orbit number and orbit start time for each orbit
description:
The CS_OPER_AUX_ORBCNT auxiliary file gives orbit number information for CryoSat-2. It is a plain-text table with one row per orbit. Each row holds the orbit number, the orbit start time (as MJD2000 and as a UTC date and time), the longitude phi_AN, and a Source flag.

Each file on the Swarm dissemination server covers the mission from 2010-04-08 onwards. Orbit 1 starts on 2010-04-08 at 15:02:26.042 UTC. New files carry a month-end stop date, and the latest one listed runs to 2026-09-30.
